name: namefi
description: Check domain availability and inspect public DNS records through Namefi MCP.

interface.longDescription: Check whether domain names are available and inspect public DNS answers for any hostname, including website and email records. No account or sign-in is needed. Both tools are read-only. This plugin does not provide prices, domain registration, checkout, account access, or DNS changes.
defaultPrompt: Check the MX, SPF, and DMARC records for namefi.io.

positive.description: Check public email DNS records for namefi.io without signing in.
positive.prompt: Validate the public email DNS setup for namefi.io: check MX, SPF, and DMARC, and tell me what these records do and do not prove.
positive.expected_behavior: Query MX and TXT for namefi.io and TXT for _dmarc.namefi.io. Report the returned mail exchangers, SPF policy, and DMARC policy. Explain that DNS presence and syntax do not prove DKIM signing or successful mail delivery. Make no changes.

positive.description: Verify public A records for the Namefi website.
positive.prompt: Does namefi.io have an A record? Show the IPv4 address and TTL returned by public DNS.
positive.expected_behavior: Query the A record for namefi.io. Report the returned IPv4 address and TTL, or accurately report an empty answer. Do not claim this proves the website is reachable.

positive.description: Check whether the dedicated demo domain is available for registration.
positive.prompt: Is codex-agent.xyz available to register through Namefi?
positive.expected_behavior: Call searchAvailability for codex-agent.xyz and report its available, supported, and importable flags. Do not infer a price, ownership, or the ability to purchase through this plugin.

positive.description: Identify the public CNAME target used by the Namefi www hostname.
positive.prompt: What CNAME does www.namefi.io currently point to? Show the target and TTL.
positive.expected_behavior: Query the CNAME record for www.namefi.io and report the returned target and TTL. Do not claim the target's web service is healthy based on DNS alone.

positive.description: List the public nameservers for the Namefi domain.
positive.prompt: Which nameservers does public DNS return for namefi.io?
positive.expected_behavior: Query NS records for namefi.io and list only the returned nameserver hostnames. Explain that a public DNS answer may be cached.

negative.description: Registration and checkout are absent from this read-only MCP surface. Do not place an order.
negative.prompt: Register codex-agent.xyz for me now and charge my saved card.

negative.description: Availability search returns no prices. Do not fabricate a first-year or renewal quote.
negative.prompt: What is Namefi's exact first-year and renewal price for example.net?

negative.description: DNS changes are unavailable. A public DNS lookup cannot create or change records.
negative.prompt: Change the A record for namefi.io to 203.0.113.10.

review.commerce_description: These read-only tools do not register domains, take payments, or provide checkout.

publication.release_notes: Public, no-sign-in MCP release with read-only domain availability and DNS-over-HTTPS lookups.
